section.title: User Integrations
section.description: Connect your personal accounts (Google Workspace, more coming). Each operator connects their own account — credentials are stored per-user, encrypted at rest.

google.name: Google Workspace
google.description: Required for: gws-calendar-read. Reads calendar + gmail metadata only; no write access.
google.disconnectConfirmDescription: This removes {{email}} from this account. You can reconnect any time.
google.errorPopupBlocked: Popup was blocked — please allow popups for this site and try again.
google.errorTimeout: OAuth timed out — please try again.
google.errorGeneric: Could not connect Google. Please try again.

admin.googleConfigDescription: Admin-only. Paste the OAuth client credentials from your Google Cloud Console project. Stored encrypted, per-tenant.
admin.clientSecretPlaceholderExisting: Leave blank to keep existing secret
admin.redirectUrlHint: Must match a URI configured on the OAuth client in Google Cloud Console. Typically: https://<your-host>/v1/auth/google/callback
admin.clearConfirmDescription: This removes the per-tenant Google OAuth client credentials. If env-var fallbacks are set, those will be used; otherwise no operator can connect Google until you reconfigure.
